annotations.title: Get a DJ's mixes, posts, events or reviews

description: What a DJ has published, in full. reviews returns the WRITTEN TEXT of each review and who left it, not just the score. Call it whenever someone asks what clients said. mixes gives their sets and where to hear them, live-events what they are playing next, posts their recent activity. An empty list can mean the DJ has none or has chosen not to show them; either way there is nothing to report.
name: get_dj_content
